# Free My TV **A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG and Samsung TVs.** Trending picks from your own apps, the weather at a glance, and a look that follows the sunset.
Open source. Built with Claude Code. One button to undo. [**freemytv.io**](https://freemytv.io) · [Install](#install) · [LG TVs](#lg-tvs-webos) · [Samsung TVs](#samsung-tvs-tizen) · [Any TV](#any-tv) · [Make it yours](#make-it-yours)
## What you get - **No ads.** No sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos. Not one. - **Your apps, front and center.** The streaming apps you actually use, on a glass shelf. Pick them and their order right on the TV. - **Trending, not sponsored.** Three fresh picks every hour (up to six, in Home Settings) from what's trending this week and the latest releases, only from apps you already have. Movies and Shows get their own tabs. - **Weather and markets, one press away.** The hour-by-hour forecast (or the next 5 days), sunrise and sunset, and live crypto prices. - **What's playing.** Music, a podcast or the radio going on in the background shows on the home screen and the screensaver: the title, the artist and the app, from any app that tells Android what it plays (*Home Settings*, off until you turn it on). - **Light by day, dark by night.** It follows your city's real sunset, the way your phone does. - **A screensaver to match.** Full-screen photos of the picks with a big glass clock. Optionally (*Watch from the screensaver*, in Home Settings), OK opens the title on screen in its app, and any other button just closes it. - **Your own photos** (Google TV and Android TV). Send them from your computer (up to 100): the screensaver shows them, and without picks one is the home screen's background each hour. - **Fast.** 60 fps, every frame in 16.6 ms, on the TV's own chip. The home screen uses 96 MB of memory instead of 242 MB (−60%).
Measured on a 98″ TCL Google TV running Android 14. - **Set up on the TV.** Language, your city, temperature, theme, how many picks and which streaming services they come from, the weather and prices cards, the forecast's hours or days, which coins, and the apps on the shelf, in Free My TV's own settings. - **Safe.** No root. Nothing is uninstalled. One button brings back the factory home screen. ## Install About ten minutes. You need a Google TV or Android TV (Android 8 or newer) and a computer on the same Wi-Fi. ### The easy way: an AI assistant 1. **On the TV**, turn on developer mode: Settings → System → About → press *Android TV OS build* 7 times. Then Settings → System → Developer options → turn on **USB debugging**. Write down the TV's IP address (Settings → Network & Internet). 2. **On your computer**, open an AI coding assistant ([Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), Codex or Antigravity) and say: > Install Free My TV (github.com/simbasjungles/free-my-tv) on my TV at 192.168.1.50. I live in Lisbon. It downloads the code, installs the tools it needs, builds the app and puts it on your TV, and asks before anything important. Swap in your TV's IP and your city. 3. **On the TV**, open *Free My TV* → *Home Screen* → *Free My TV*. That's when the TV asks *Allow USB debugging?* for Free My TV: tick *Always allow* and accept. ### The ready APK No tools to install besides adb. The APK on the [latest release](https://github.com/simbasjungles/free-my-tv/releases/latest) has no TMDB key: add yours on the TV for the picks (*Home Settings* → *TMDB key*, [below](#the-tmdb-key)). It takes your city from the TV's time zone (change it in *Home Settings* → *City*). 1. **On the TV**, do step 1 above. 2. **On your computer**, download `FreeMyTV.apk` from the release and install it: ```bash adb connect 192.168.1.50:5555 adb install -r FreeMyTV.apk ``` On Android 14, Google Play Protect may hold the install with *Risky app blocked*: choose *More details* → *Install anyway*. 3. **On the TV**, do step 3 above. If you built Free My TV yourself before, switch back to *Original* and uninstall it first: your build and the release are signed with different keys. For the picks, add your TMDB key in *Home Settings* → *TMDB key* (below). **Updates come to the TV.** Once a week the APK from the release looks for a newer release and downloads it; the home screen then says so once, and *Home Settings* → *Updates* (the last row) installs it through Android's installer, which asks first (and, the first time, asks to allow Free My TV to install apps). OK on *Updates* also checks right away. The download must come from this repository's releases, match the size and SHA-256 GitHub lists, be newer, and be signed with the project's key. A build you made yourself checks only when you press *Updates*

Your TV should do what you paid for.
Ads, tracking and clutter out of your Fire TV. Your apps and HDMI inputs stay.

dumbtv.org · Get started · What it blocks · Devices · Get help

As seen in TechCrunch · TechRadar · Tom's Guide · Gizmodo · XDA · It's FOSS · and more than 100 others

--- ## The story I had a Fire TV Edition television that had become painful to use. Menus lagged, apps took ages to open, and the home screen was mostly ads. When I looked, it had 129 MB of free memory, and much of the rest went to apps that started on their own and to Amazon services that report what you watch. So I asked a coding agent to clean it up over ADB, and [posted what happened](https://x.com/DevMuzzammil/status/2111595814099591535). People asked for the scripts, so I put them here and [shared them](https://x.com/DevMuzzammil/status/2111912547318395338). Since then, owners of about twenty other TVs and sticks have run it and sent back what they found. dumbtv is that cleanup, made safe to run on someone else's TV. ## What it does On a Fire TV stick, Cube or Fire TV Edition television, from your computer, with no root: - **Removes the ads and tracking.** Disables Amazon's sponsored rows, ad services, screen fingerprinting (ACR), telemetry and experiments, and turns off ad tracking and usage reporting. - **Blocks what cannot be disabled.** A small open-source DNS filter on the TV stops Amazon's telemetry and automatic updates from reaching their servers. Everything else, including your streaming apps, works as before. - **Replaces the home screen** with [dumbtv home](launcher/README.md): your apps, your inputs and a clock. 54 KB, open source, no internet access, no permissions. - **Leaves your apps alone.** Nothing you watch is removed unless you name it. - **Can all be undone** with one command. ## Quick start You need a computer with [`adb`](https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools) and about ten minutes. On the TV, turn on ADB: **Settings → My Fire TV → About**, press OK on the device name 7 times, then **Developer Options → ADB debugging**. The TV's IP address is under **Settings → My Fire TV → About → Network** (on a Fire TV Edition television: **Settings → Network**, then the connected network). **With a coding agent** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and others): clone this repository, open the agent in it, and say: > Clean up my Fire TV. Its IP address is _(the address from the Network screen)_. It reads [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), asks you a few questions, and runs the steps below. **By hand:** ```sh git clone https://github.com/humblemuzzu/dumbtv && cd dumbtv adb connect :5555 # press Allow on the TV ./scripts/preflight.sh # what the TV is and what would change;

# AgentCraft **A team of Claude agents doing real work on your code, inside a Minecraft studio you can walk around in.** *Powered by Claude* [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-c9a227)](LICENSE) [![Minecraft 26.3](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-26.3-8fa98b)](https://www.minecraft.net) [![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/mod%20loader-Fabric-d97757)](https://fabricmc.net) [![Claude Agent SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/agents-Claude%20Agent%20SDK-2fa3a0)](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-548%20passing-3b2a20)](foreman/test)

Multi-agent coding usually means a wall of terminal text. AgentCraft turns it into a place. You type a goal. A lead agent reads your repo, writes a plan and pins tasks to a wall. Workers walk to their desks, sit down and start coding in their own git worktrees while their monitors stream every file they read and every line they change. When a call is genuinely yours, an agent walks over to you with a question. When work is ready, you review the real diff and press **Merge**. Nothing touches your branch without that click, and nothing is ever pushed. Close the game and the agents keep working. Open it again and the studio catches up.
## How a goal plays out
**1. You give a goal.** Press ` and type it. `@juniper` messages a specific agent, with Tab completion. **2. The lead plans.** Marlow splits the goal into tasks with dependencies. They land on the Task Wall, and the plan goes into the shared library.
**3. The team builds.** Each worker codes in its own worktree. Monitors stream the live log: tool calls, test runs, red and green diffs. **4. They come to you.** A clay ! appears, the bell rings, the agent walks to the podium. Press J to answer.
**5. You review and merge.** A real code review screen: file list, line numbers, collapsed context, the worker's summary and the reviewer's notes. **6. Memory stays shared.** The lead's plan, decisions and repo conventions live in a library every agent reads, and you can too.

## Meet the team Six hand-pixelled characters, each with their own silhouette and colour. **Marlow** leads: he plans, splits work and reviews. **Juniper, Kit, Wren, Rowan and Tove** build. They walk the studio with real pathfinding, sit at their desks while they type, show what they are doing with small particles and nameplates, talk in speech bubbles, and come find you when they need a decision.
## The studio
The Goal Atrium. Progress ring, task counts, and how many decisions need you. The studio floor. Desks, status lamps, the library and the lounge.
Everything is information you can read at a glance. Far away, the lamps and the cupola beacon tell you who is working, who is stuck and who is waiting on you. Closer, nameplates and cards tell you what. Up close, monitors and screens tell you exactly how.
## Proven with real agents This is not a mockup. These screenshots come from a real run with Claude agents on a sample repo, driven entirely through the game: a goal typed into the console, questions and permission prompts answered in game, merges reviewed in the diff screen, including a merge conflict sent back to the worker and resolved. The game was restarted mid run and the Foreman was taken offline and brought back. Six features landed in the repo with its tests passing.

Apple Watch Companion

Android · macOS · Linux · Windows
Native protocols. Physical hardware. A shared Companion.
Bluetooth · Pairing · IDS · Native Faces · Flutter · Java · Rust

     

Start here · Call map · Pairing · API · Build · Evidence

--- ## English

⚠️ TESTED ONLY ON watchOS 26.2 (23S303)

**Android Magisk module:** [Download Bridge 0.2.427 ZIP](https://github.com/LordixDemon/apple_watch_connector/releases/download/magisk-0.2.427/apple-watch-bridge-magisk-0.2.427.zip) · [Installation](#en-android-install) **Connect Apple Watch to Android, Linux and Windows through native Bluetooth/IDS protocols and a shared Flutter Companion. macOS uses the same interface with a limited Bluetooth backend.** This project reconstructs the path from discovery and pairing to activation, reconnection, preference exchange, and native watch-face management. Companion presents observed Watch state and submits commands on all four platforms. Android Bridge owns the phone connection and keys. Linux and Windows use a Rust desktop backend, native HCI brokers and the shared Java protocol engine; macOS uses Rust and CoreBluetooth. Linux and Windows pairing uses the six-digit Watch code; camera pairing is available on Android. See the [release guide](docs/BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md). Fresh pairing, activation and same-pair encrypted reconnect are physically verified on Linux and Windows with the tested hardware; desktop application service coverage remains partial. The Linux Rust backend separates observed state, worker I/O/lifetime and command routing. Stop/failure states reject late ready events; EOF and bounded cleanup prevent stale readiness and abandoned workers. Portable Java modules share strict dependency locks. Linux packages include a verified schema-2 inventory and use deterministic archive metadata. See [stage 93](docs/REFACTOR_RELEASE_93.md). Source versions: Bridge **0.2.429 / code 629**, Companion **1.0.86+87**, Rust workspace **0.1.1**. Source versions do not establish installed device versions. content.readme:
# tv-home

**Make a slow, ad-filled Android TV fast and clean again.** Debloat it over Wi-Fi and give it a
tiny Apple TV-style home screen with rotating nature wallpapers. You can hand the whole thing to
Claude Code with one prompt, or do it by hand with the scripts here.

![Before: Google TV home with a sponsored hero. After: clean dock over a Lake Louise wallpaper](before-after.png)

On a 2 GB TCL Google TV this disabled 25 bloat apps and cut the home screen's memory use from
192 MB to 83 MB. Everything is reversible: packages are disabled, never uninstalled.

## Do it with Claude Code (easiest)

1. On the TV: Settings → System → About → press OK on **Build** 7 times → back → Developer options
   → turn on **USB debugging**. Keep the TV on, on the same Wi-Fi as your computer.
2. Clone this repo, open Claude Code inside it (so it can reuse the launcher and scripts), and paste:

   ```text
   My Android TV is slow and full of ads. Find it on my Wi-Fi, connect over ADB, and debloat it:
   disable the manufacturer's ads, telemetry and junk (reversibly, never uninstall), asking me first
   about apps and features I might use. Then build and install a fast, minimal Apple TV-style home
   screen with a dock of my favourite apps and rotating nature wallpapers. Back up before changing
   anything, check every step with screenshots from the TV, and give me a restore script.

   Heads-up from people who've done this: use the adb-shell Python package if macOS blocks adb; on
   Google TV also disable com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith or it hijacks the Home button; and
   test the Home button from inside an app.
   ```

3. Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV when asked, then answer a few questions: which apps you
   use, which go in the dock, whether you want wallpapers.

The prompt is short on purpose; Claude works out the details. The gotchas below are there in case it gets stuck.

## Do it by hand (macOS)

```bash
./setup.sh                                                  # Python ADB client, JDK 17, Android SDK
tools/find-tv.sh                                            # finds the TV, saves its IP
tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py --probe                # model, Android version
tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-google-tv-g07/debloat.txt     # or your own list, see examples/
launcher/build-and-install.sh                               # build + install the launcher
```

Undo everything with `tools/restore.sh <the same list>`.

## What's here

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) | The prompt for Claude Code / any coding agent |
| [launcher/](launcher/) | The home screen. 4.7 MB including the wallpapers; plain Android, no network, no background services |
| [launcher/res/values/config.xml](launcher/res/values/config.xml) | Dock apps, hidden apps, Live TV app, grid columns |
| [tools/tv.py](tools/tv.py) | Pure-Python ADB client: shell, batch, screenshots, chunked APK push |
| [tools/find-tv.sh](tools/find-tv.sh) | Finds Android TVs on your Wi-Fi |
| [tools/type.sh](tools/type.sh) | Type into the TV's on-screen keyboard from your laptop (`tools/type.sh` alone prompts hidden, for passwords) |
| [tools/disable.sh](tools/disable.sh), [tools/restore.sh](tools/restore.sh) | Apply / undo a debloat list |
| [examples/](examples/) | Debloat lists per TV model |

## The launcher

- Clock, greeting and date top-left. Frosted pills top-right for **Inputs** (HDMI/AV/Live TV
  dropdown; the remote's Menu key opens it too), **Wi-Fi** (shows the network name) and **Settings**.
- A dock of your favourite apps. The focused app's name appears above it over a glow coloured from
  its banner. Press Down for every other app in a grid.
- 12 nature photos crossfade every 10 minutes, with a scrim so text stays readable. Swap them in
  `launcher/assets/wallpapers/` (1920×1080 JPEGs, credits in `launcher/WALLPAPER-CREDITS.md`).
- Deterministic D-pad focus, remembers the last tile, picks up newly installed apps on return.

Change the dock: edit `config.xml`, then run `launcher/build-and-install.sh`.

## Gotchas we hit

- **macOS blocks the `adb` binary** on the local network ("No route to host"). `tools/tv.py` uses
  the `adb-shell` Python package instead.
- **Google TV hijacks the Home button.** With the stock launcher disabled, the setup app
  (`com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith`) has a higher HOME priority than any third-party
  launcher. The install script disables it; `restore.sh` re-enables it.
- **Home opened the launcher behind the current app**, because of a stale home task from switching
  launchers. Force-stopping the launcher and `com.android.tv.settings` and pressing Home fixes it.
  The install script does this.
- **Chained `pm` commands** (`pm disable a; pm disable b`) can silently stop after the first. The
  scripts run one per shell call.
- **Apps installed from the Play Store didn't appear**, because the package broadcast was missed
  while another app was in front. The launcher re-checks wit

``` wget https://github.com/opentrap/opentrap/releases/latest/download/opentrap-x86_64.appimage && chmod +x opentrap-x86_64.appimage && ./opentrap-x86_64.appimage ```

# RTX Remix for Minecraft

Play Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 with real-time path tracing on a GeForce RTX
GPU, powered by NVIDIA RTX Remix.

## What To Expect

This is a beta. It was built as a technology showcase, but we love Minecraft
and want it to succeed as a rendering mod. We tuned it against one showcase
world, built for this project by [BlockWorks](https://www.blockworks.uk/) (see
[Showcase World And Art Pack](#showcase-world-and-art-pack)), and the places
that world visits are where it looks and runs best. We have worked hard to fix
as many issues as we could, but it ships with
[known issues](https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/rtx-remix-minecraft/issues),
and there are certainly bugs yet to be discovered.

Three areas have had less attention than the rest:

- **Other mods.** It has had limited testing alongside other mods, and a
  renderer that takes over the scene the way this one does is likely to
  conflict with anything that changes rendering or the chunk pipeline.
- **A full playthrough.** Blocks, mobs, dimensions, and situations the showcase
  never reaches have had less care, and some will look wrong or run slowly.
- **Other versions.** It targets Minecraft 1.21.1 only, chosen because that is
  where the modding community is today. Ports to newer versions are something
  we hope the community takes on.

We hope the community helps fill it out. If something breaks,
[report it](docs/PLAYING.md#reporting-a-bug); if you can fix it, see
[Contributing](#contributing).

## Download

Download the release archive from the
[Releases page](https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/rtx-remix-minecraft/releases/latest).

## Install in three steps

1. Extract the release archive.
2. Double-click `install.bat` and follow the menu.
3. Launch the **NVIDIA RTX Remix for Minecraft** profile from your launcher.

The step-by-step version, with launcher advice and troubleshooting, is in
[Playing](docs/PLAYING.md).

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, x64 or ARM64.
- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1, on a Microsoft account that owns the game.
- A GeForce RTX 30-series or newer GPU with NVIDIA driver 616.92 or newer.
- About 5 GB of free disk space while installing; about 3 GB stays in use.
- An internet connection while the installer runs.
- 16 GB of system memory is recommended.

Java 21, Fabric, and the RTX Remix runtime are installed for you.

Building and running from source has its own
[prerequisites](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md#prerequisites), including Prism
Launcher, signed in to a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.

## Crash Reports And Privacy

The mod collects no data of its own. The RTX Remix runtime it carries can send
basic session information and crash reports to NVIDIA. Its First Use Guide asks
about both, with both on by default, and the Permissions tab of the RTX Remix
Graphics Settings menu changes them at any time.
[Crash Reports And Privacy](docs/PLAYING.md#crash-reports-and-privacy) lists
what is sent.

through glass, and out of torches the way it does in a film renderer, so shadows,
reflections, and the colour a nearby block casts on its neighbours are all
computed rather than painted in.

**The look follows the game.** Time of day, weather, and being underwater each
bring their own lighting, and a map author can attach a look to a place in the
world. Nothing needs switching on.

**A new block.** The Copper Beacon is a directional lamp you can place or
carry, and its beam is a real light that picks out walls, rain, and anything
standing in it.

**Camera flythroughs.** Record a path by walking it, then replay it, for a video
or for an exact before-and-after comparison.

**A settings screen in the game.** Distances, framerate, sky, lighting,
exposure, and materials, all in Options, with no config files to edit, and a
button into Remix's own Graphics Settings for the quality tier.

## Showcase World And Art Pack

Two optional extras go with the mod. The developer launcher in
[`tools/`](tools/README.md) downloads both the first time it runs and launches

# mcopt

> [!NOTE]
> mcopt no longer requires Sodium 🎉

A Minecraft performance mod for Apple Silicon Macs. Since 0.3.0-alpha.1 it draws the world with its own Metal renderer.
**Very much alpha:** expect bugs, and back up your worlds.

## Requirements

- An Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 26 or later
- Java 25 (the official launcher and Prism download it for 26.3; nothing to install)
- Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer

## Install

1. Install Fabric for Minecraft 26.3: https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/ (or in Prism Launcher: new instance, 26.3,
   loader Fabric).
2. Download the mcopt jar from [Releases](../../releases).
3. Put it in `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods`. Create the `mods` folder if it's missing
   (Finder: Go > Go to Folder). In Prism: Edit the instance > Mods > Add file.
4. Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

Sodium isn't needed anymore: mcopt won't start alongside it, so take Sodium out of that folder if it's there. Fabric API
isn't required; keep it if your other mods need it.

To check it's working: press F3 (fn + F3 on a Mac keyboard); the bottom right says `Metal 3 (mcopt)`.

Shows an fps counter in the top-left corner (hidden with F1 or F3; fn + F1 or fn + F3 on a Mac keyboard).

## Settings

- The perf profile is on by default.
- `profile=none` in `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/config/mcopt.properties` (in Prism, the instance's
  `minecraft/config` folder) turns it off. The first launch writes that file.
- Far terrain is an experimental opt-in: `mcopt.lod=true` in the same file, for Macs with 10 or more GPU cores.

## Numbers

fps spinning / flying, same test world, 1920x1080, render distance 16, VSync off, at least two runs each:

| Mac | vanilla | Sodium 0.9.3 | 0.2.0-alpha.3 | 0.3.0-alpha.1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mac mini M4 (10-core GPU, 16 GB) | 156 / 146 | 275-281 / 253-267 | 1202-1223 / 1068-1074 | 1209-1211 / 1068-1069 |
| MacBook Neo (A18 Pro, 5-core GPU, 8 GB) | 79-81 / 69-72 | 133-146 / 85-91 | 514-579 / 422-449 | 591-638 / 477-504 |
| Mac mini M6 (12-core GPU, 16 GB) | 297-328 / 283-291 | 454-460 / 406-413 | 1988-1991 / 1738-1742 | 2020-2022 / 1690-1704 |

The mini and Neo cells ran on 6c133ecc, whose only difference from 9865a0a3 is vGroup, which is gated off on those GPUs. The Neo's vanilla and Sodium cells come from the da566d00 run. This build differs from 9865a0a3 only in code that runs when Distant Horizons is installed.

For the most fps: Options > Video Settings, VSync off and Max Framerate Unlimited. The numbers above are with VSync off.

## Known issues

- Mods that require Sodium (for example Better Block Entities or Iris) can't be used with this build.
- Mods that call OpenGL directly can't draw on the Metal backend. To switch mcopt's renderer off, add
  `mcopt.metal=false` to `config/mcopt.properties` (or launch with `-Dmcopt.metal=false`).
- Distant Horizons runs on the Metal renderer next to mcopt's own terrain. With DH set to its OpenGL renderer, mcopt
  switches its renderer off for it.
- Far terrain is experimental. On Macs with fewer than 10 GPU cores, it costs most of the fps.

## Plans

- Far terrain on by default, with tiers for smaller Macs
- Our own shaders (BSL-level) as an option
- Faster world generation (native noise, bit-exact)
- More exact server-tick and chunk optimizations, held for later alphas
- Faster startup
- Wider hardware testing

## Licence and credits

[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). Keep the [NOTICE](NOTICE) file with any copy, and credit mcopt.

# tv-vibehack 📺✨

> **Transform any ad-bloated Android TV or Google TV into a lightning-fast, tvOS-inspired, fail-safe experience — without root, without bootloop risks, and without losing access to stock features.**

[![Android 14 Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-14%20(API%2034)-green.svg)](https://developer.android.com/about/versions/14)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Root Required: No](https://img.shields.io/badge/Root-Not%20Required-brightgreen.svg)](#)
[![Zero Bootloop Architecture](https://img.shields.io/badge/Architecture-100%25%20Fail--Safe-orange.svg)](#the-100-fail-safe-architecture)

---

## 📐 Architecture & Transformation Overview

```text
[ STOCK GOOGLE TV ]                             [ NLRC TV VIBEHACK ]
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Sponsored Ad Banner (70% Screen)    │        │  NLRC Home · Ambient Clock & Date    │
│  [Trending Shows] [Paid Promotions]  │        │                                      │
│  50+ Bloatware OTT Apps              │   ➔    │                                      │
│  Remote Buttons Lock You In Paywalls │        │  Dock: [HDMI 2 (Cable)] [Media Vault]│
└──────────────────────────────────────┘        └──────────────────────────────────────┘
   • 2.5 GB RAM used                               • 120 MB RAM used
   • Heavy telemetry & tracking                    • 0 Ads · 0 Telemetry · 100% Fail-Safe
```

---

## 🎯 The Motivation

Modern Smart TVs ship with:
- **Sponsored ads covering 70% of the screen**.
- **Sluggish bloatware** and 50+ pre-installed background apps consuming memory and tracking habits.
- **Unremappable sponsored remote buttons** (Netflix, Prime Video) that elderly family members hit by mistake, throwing them into subscription walls.
- **Overly complicated navigation** that makes switching to Cable/HDMI or playing personal home videos a headache.

**tv-vibehack** solves this permanently. Originally built to give aging parents a distraction-free, one-touch TV experience, it provides a universal blueprint for taking back control of any Android TV without root.

---

## ⚡ What Makes This Different?

### 1. 🛡️ The 100% Fail-Safe Architecture (Zero Bootloops)
On Android 14 Google TV, disabling the stock launcher (`com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`) breaks Direct Boot, tripping Android's `RescueParty` service and bricking the TV into a black-screen recovery state.

**tv-vibehack never disables `launcherx`.** Instead:
- The custom launcher is **`directBootAware="true"`**.
- A lightweight native **Accessibility Service** (`HomeKeyService`) intercepts Home key events and window transitions in under 10ms.
- If the custom launcher is ever uninstalled or crashes, Google TV seamlessly takes over. **Zero chance of bricking your TV.**

### 2. 🔀 Hardware Passthrough (Direct HDMI Switching)
No more opening 4 nested TV menus just to watch cable. Through reverse-engineered Realtek RTD `TvContract` passthrough URIs, the launcher switches directly to HDMI inputs programmatically:
```java
Uri uri = TvContract.buildChannelUriForPassthroughInput(
    "com.realtek.tv.passthrough/.hdmiinput.HDMITvInputService/HW151519744" // HDMI 2
);
context.startActivity(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri));
```

### 3. 🎮 Sponsored Remote Key Remapping (No Root)
`HomeKeyService` intercepts hardcoded hardware remote buttons (`KEYCODE_BUTTON_3` for Netflix, `KEYCODE_BUTTON_4` for Prime Video, `KEYCODE_PROG_RED`/`GREEN`) and redirects them straight to HDMI 2 / Set-Top Box in <150ms without root.

### 4. 🎞️ Offline TV Media Vault & Legacy Transcoding
Many families have legacy home videos or recordings stored on USB drives encoded in older formats (e.g., DVD MPEG-2) that native modern Smart TV chipsets cannot decode inside standard MP4 containers.

#### How to Add Your Own Media:
1. **Transcode to Hardware-Accelerated H.264:**
   ```bash
   ffmpeg -i "MyVideo_Part_1.mp4" -c:v libx264 -preset faster -crf 23 -c:a aac -b:a 192k "Part_1.mp4"
   ```
2. **Push Directly into TV Internal Storage:**
   ```bash
   adb shell mkdir -p /sdcard/Movies/NLRC
   adb push Part_1.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_1.mp4
   adb push Part_2.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_2.mp4
   adb push Part_3.mp4 /sdcard/Movies/NLRC/Part_3.mp4
   ```
3. **Instant D-pad Remote Navigation:**
   Launch **PenDrive / Media Viewer** directly from the dock. No USB stick needs to remain plugged in; videos play natively at 60fps with intuitive remote controls:
   - ◄ / ►: Seek -10s / +10s with real-time HUD.
   - ▲ / ▼ or CH+ / CH-: Switch to Next / Previous part.
   - OK: Play / Pause toggle.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Enable ADB on your Android TV
1. On the TV: **Settings** → **System** → **About** → Click **Build** 7 times to enable Developer Options.
2. Go to **Settings** → **System** → **Developer Options** → Turn on **USB Debugging** (and Network Debugging if available).
3. Connect your computer to the same Wi-Fi

**v0.3.0：统一设置与全新 Dock。** 壁纸、布局、字体、焦点和首页编辑都在「设置」中；操作见 [设置指南](docs/SETTINGS.md)。横向 Dock 使用宽幅圆角毛玻璃底板和大图标，入口较多时随遥控器焦点平滑滚动。

项目背景见 **[v0.2.0 项目介绍与使用指南](docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.zh-CN.md)**：与 cleanYourTV、CleanFrame 的区别，实际改造与优势，安装、遥控器操作、壁纸设置和源码定制。

这是从个人电视上的定制版本整理出的公开版。目前重点适配小米电视 **MiTV-MTSU0**，不是面向所有 Android TV 的通用桌面替换工具。上图为布局示意；实际内置照片见 [壁纸预览与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)。

**main 天气试用功能（尚未发布 APK）：** 时间右侧可显示天气，支持自动城市与手动选城。默认关闭，开启后联网；[试用说明与数据来源](docs/WEATHER.md)。正式下载仍为 v0.3.0。

## 能做什么

- 左侧大字列表：PlayStation 5、Apple TV、哔哩哔哩、小米投屏、相册、小米原桌面。
- 在已适配机型上，PlayStation 5 直达 HDMI 2，Apple TV 直达 HDMI 1。
- 操作区保留全部应用、其他信号源、设置（列表右下角，Dock 右上角）；壁纸统一进入「设置 → 背景」。
- 设置使用圆角选项与嵌入式首页预览；浏览壁纸时，预览和整页高斯模糊背景同步变化。
- 首页支持列表 / Dock、统一单色 SVG 图标 / 文字、字体风格与字号；毛玻璃焦点按内容宽度包裹，无长条描边。
- 首页 1–9 项，可添加、隐藏、排序和撤销编辑；默认六项不变。
- 壁纸支持固定选择、自动轮播，默认每 5 分钟切换；可选 1 / 5 / 15 / 30 分钟。
- 淡入淡出切换壁纸，离开桌面后暂停计时，返回后重新计时。
- 遥控器方向键操作，记住上次选中的入口和壁纸偏好。
- 基础桌面不需要账号或无障碍服务，不下载或预装视频 App。main 的可选天气和 Codex 实验默认关闭；后者需要电脑上的 Codex 登录及相应额度。v0.3.0 正式版仍不联网。
- 支持实验性开机自动进入：默认关闭，适配机型需先完成一次 ADB 配置，详见 [启用与恢复说明](docs/BOOT-START.md)。

公开版自带五张经过来源核对的 Unsplash 照片：雾中雪岭、雨林山路、热带绿叶、山间彩虹、流光花影。图片适用 [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license)，代码适用 MIT；[完整来源与署名](docs/WALLPAPERS.md)随源码和 APK 保存。其余版权未确认的照片未纳入。也可以用自己的图片构建。

## 安装与使用

从 [Releases](https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv/releases) 下载 APK，通过电视支持的本地安装方式安装。也可以在开启电视 ADB 调试、电脑连接同一网络后执行：

```sh
adb connect <电视IP>:5555
adb install -r guizang-tv-v0.3.0.apk
```

端口和调试方式取决于电视固件。首次连接请在电视上确认调试授权；使用结束后可以关闭调试。

安装后，在小米原桌面的应用列表中打开 **归藏电视**。

| 遥控器操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 上 / 下 | 列表与其操作区切换项目；Dock 向上进入操作区，向下返回应用 |
| 右 | 列表进入操作区；Dock 向右选择应用 |
| 左 | 列表操作区返回上次应用；Dock 的应用和操作区均向左选择 |
| 确认 | 打开选中项目 |
| 返回 | 关闭面板；从操作区回到主列表；适配机型上从主列表回小米原桌面 |
| Home | 按系统原有设置工作，应用不拦截按键 |

**建议先作为普通应用试用。** 已测试的 HyperOS 固件会忽略第三方默认桌面选择，因此本项目不接管 Home 键。可在已适配机型上配置开机自动进入，需开启应用内开关并设置系统目标；这与默认桌面选择是两回事。无需禁用原桌面，小爱同学、手机投屏、直播及 HDMI 系统组件均保留。真实语音、投屏、直播播放仍需自行验证。

未配置开机自动进入时，卸载「归藏电视」即可结束试用。已经配置的用户先按 [关闭与恢复步骤](docs/BOOT-START.md) 停用并核对系统目标，避免缓存调用或降级旧版后行为变化。公开版包名为 `io.github.op7418.guizangtv`，不会覆盖上游 cleanYourTV，也不会覆盖原有私人试用版，设置不会自动迁移。

## 让 AI 帮你配置

可将本仓库交给 Codex、Claude Code 或其他 AI 编程助手。AI 入口是 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) / [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)，完整流程见 [AI 适配与引导指南](docs/AI-SETUP.md)，涵盖其他安卓设备、Mac、Windows、Linux 电脑、配对、语音测试和故障定位。

可以直接说：

> 请阅读 AGENTS.md 和 docs/AI-SETUP.md，检查我的安卓设备与电脑环境，保留已有设置，指导我手动开启 Codex 实验并完成配对。先验证文字和重复进入，再测试语音；说明已通过和未验证的能力，不公开凭证。

目前完整实测组合是指定小米电视与 Mac。Windows/Linux 和其他安卓设备提供适配路径，尚不代表全面兼容；电脑运行连接服务，Android APK 不会因此变成电脑原生桌面。

## 从源码构建

要求：**JDK 17、Gradle 8.9、Android SDK Platform 34、Build Tools 34.0.0**。

仓库只包含源码；Gradle 请通过 [官方发行版](https://gradle.org/releases/) 安装。也可以用 Android Studio 打开项目，并选择本地 Gradle 8.9。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/op7418/guizang-tv.git
cd guizang-tv
export ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/Android/sdk
export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk-17
gradle :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug
```

生成文件：`app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`。首次构建需要联网下载 Android Gradle Plugin 和测试依赖，基础桌面离线可用；开启天气或 Codex 实验后，相应功能需要网络。

CI 会构建 Debug APK 并执行测试、lint；下载 Actions 产物需要登录 GitHub。Debug 包用于自行测试，不保证与 Releases 的正式签名兼容。

Release 构建：

```sh
gradle :app:assembleRelease :app:testReleaseUnitTest :app:lintRelease
```

未设置签名时输出未签名 APK。维护者可在本地配置 `GUIZANG_KEYSTORE`、`GUIZANG_STORE_PASSWORD`、`GUIZANG_KEY_ALIAS`（默认 `guizang-tv`）和 `GUIZANG_KEY_PASSWORD`（默认同 store password），再构建签名版本。密钥和密码不应提交到 Git。

## 使用自己的壁纸

目前支持**构建时打包**，电视端可以从已打包的图片中选择；尚未提供电视端文件导入功能。

准备 1–15 张 JPEG / PNG / WebP 图片，然后：

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install Pillow
.venv/bin/python scripts/prepare_wallpapers.py /path/to/your/wallpapers
gradle :app:assembleDebug
```

脚本保留原图，为电视生成最长边 1920 像素的副本与缩略图，并去除 EXIF。生成内容放在 Git 忽略的 `app/src/main/assets/wallpapers/local/` 中。重新构建后，桌面会优先使用这组图片，内置照片仍随 APK 保留；文件名作为壁纸名称。请只分发有权公开使用的图片。

重复运行时，上一份生成结果会移到本地 `.wallpaper-backups/` 保留，避免旧照片混进新的安装包；备份目录也不进入 Git。

如需恢复默认的五张照片，将 `local/` 移到项目目录外备份，再重新构建。没有照片目录时会回退到五种渐变背景。

## 修改入口与适配电视

- 首页可在「设置 → 首页内容」编辑。默认名称、包名和顺序位于 [HomeItems.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/HomeItems.java)，应用启动由 FrameHomeActivity 处理。
- 小米接口集中在 [XiaomiControls.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/XiaomiControls.java)。HDMI 参数只在已验证机型上启用，不能仅添加机型名就视为完成适配。
- 分组设置位于 HomeSettings，首页及预览共用 HomeSurface；壁纸加载与轮播逻辑在 [FrameWallpapers.java](app/src/main/java/io/github/op7418/guizangtv/FrameWallpapers.java)。
- 当前 PS5 / Apple TV 是入口名称，不代表自动识别到设备。请按实际接线修改端口。
- 应用未安装时会显示提示；项目没有代装应用、账号登录或内容破解功能。

欢迎通过 Issue 提交电视型号、Android / 固件版本和复现步骤。请隐去局域网地址、序列号、账号及调试密钥。

## 来源与致谢

本项目起步于 [Gathin23/cleanyourtv](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv) 的本地定制，整理时提取了本次实现的原生列表桌面及小米适配。公开版不包含上游

content.readme:
![HushGram. Keep the moments. Cut the noise.](assets/readme-hero.png)

If HushGram makes Instagram better for you, a coffee helps me keep testing patches and maintaining them as Instagram changes.

# HushGram HushGram is a set of [Morphe](https://morphe.software) patches for Instagram on Android. You bring the Instagram APK, Morphe Manager patches it on your phone, and you get an Instagram with a settings screen full of switches the stock app doesn't have. Hide ads, suggested posts and Meta AI. Strip tracking tags from the links you share. Watch stories and lives without landing on the viewer list. Save reels, stories, photos and voice messages, lock your chats, rearrange the tab bar and a lot more. Most switches start off, so a freshly patched Instagram looks like Instagram until you turn something on. It's the Instagram member of a small family. [Hushfacebook](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook) does the same job for Facebook, and HushGram is built on its foundation. The latest release is [v0.0.16](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/releases/tag/v0.0.16), with 117 patches. Add it to Morphe Manager with [this link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushGram). The source on main is HushGram v0.0.17. It hasn't been released yet. What changed in each version is in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). This project has no connection to Meta or to the Morphe project. Neither endorses it, and neither wrote it. ## Install 1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.2.0 or newer. 2. Add HushGram as a patch source by opening [this link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushGram) on your phone. Or in Manager open **Sources**, tap **+**, choose **Remote** and enter `github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram`. Use HushGram as your only Instagram source, since mixing in another one can stop patching. 3. Get Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 from APKMirror. Take [the bundle labelled (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+), build 385914283](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/instagram/instagram-instagram/instagram-453-0-0-55-79-release/). The version's other builds work too (see [Supported Instagram builds](#supported-instagram-builds)). 4. Uninstall the Instagram you got from the Play Store. The patched app is signed with your own key, so Android won't install it over Meta's. Uninstalling signs you out, so have your password and two-factor codes ready. On a rooted phone, Manager's Root Mount can lay HushGram over the Play Store app instead, and you stay signed in. 5. In Morphe Manager, pick the Instagram file, keep the default patch selection or change it, and patch. 6. Open HushGram settings and turn on what you want. It's at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity. A long press on the Instagram logo at the top of your feed opens it too. Prefer a local source? Download the `.mpp` file from the [latest release](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/releases/latest) and add it through **Sources > + > Local**. It won't update itself, and it's a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. When a patch can't find its target in your Instagram file, patching stops with a message saying what's missing instead of handing you an app that quietly does nothing. Please report a stop like that. ## Before you sign in > [!WARNING] > Meta's [Terms of Use](https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870) don't allow modified versions of its apps, and Meta can disable accounts that break them. Nobody outside Meta knows what gets an account suspended, so nobody can promise yours won't be. > > - **Assume Meta can tell.** A patched Instagram has a different signing certificate, and Instagram 450 carries Play Integrity and Keystore attestation code. `Restore trust on re-signed builds` keeps parts of the app working on a re-signed build, but it doesn't make the APK Meta-signed. > - **Try a spare account first** if you'd rather not put the one you care about on the line. People whose accounts were suspended on patched Instagram often describe a new or long-idle account signing in on a fresh install. That's what they saw, not a proven cause. > - **Keep the sign-in you have.** Upda

basic_info.description: Apple TV-style launcher for Android TV — ready-to-install APK, no build needed. Apple TV 风格的 Android TV 桌面 —— 装完即用，无需编译。Based on Gathin23/tv-vibehack (CleanYourTV).

content.readme:
[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

---

# tvhome-zh

把 Android TV / Google TV 换成 **Apple TV（tvOS）风格**桌面的开源项目，**装完就能用，不折腾**。

**本仓库是 [Gathin23/tv-vibehack](https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack) 的衍生分支**，遵循原项目 MIT
许可证，版权归原作者 Gathin 所有（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [NOTICE](NOTICE.md)）。**非官方项目**，与原作者
及上游社区无隶属关系。

> 上游现已更名为 **CleanYourTV**（官网 [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv)），tv-vibehack 的旧链接会重定向过去。
> 上游版本更新更快、功能更多，但设计前提是"你会用 AI 帮你折腾电视"；本仓库解决的是另一件事。

上游的原话是「一个 GitHub 仓库、一个 AI 和十分钟」。它把清理电视的整套方法做成了提示词和脚本，
交给 Claude Code 之类的助手去你家电视上执行——**这套东西需要你愿意折腾**。

本仓库走的是另一条路：**把上游那些"要改配置文件、要重新编译、要推文件"的设置项，全部变成按遥控器就能操作。**
所以它适合这样一类人：

- 想换掉臃肿的广告桌面，但**不想装 JDK、不想编译、不想敲命令行**；
- 家里有老人用电视，希望**开机就是能看的画面**，不需要有人先"配置"一下；
- 中文电视系统，或者干脆想要界面全中文。

如果你要的是上游的全部功能（主题目录、模块卡片、250 KB 瘦身构建等），或者你本来就喜欢自己动手折腾，
**请直接用[上游项目](https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack)**——它更新更快、功能更多。

## 📦 下载

**➜ [下载最新版 tvhome-zh APK](https://github.com/mclhm8182/tvhome-zh/releases/latest)** · 仅 **373 KB**，纯 Java，无广告 SDK

前往 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/mclhm8182/tvhome-zh/releases) 查看全部版本。

> 上游目前仍**不提供编译好的安装包**（其 release 只附源码），需要自行安装 JDK/SDK 并运行
> `launcher/build-and-install.sh` 编译。本仓库**直接提供编译好的 APK**，一条 `adb install` 就能装上
> ——在"不想折腾"这件事上，这是最实际的差别。

## 这不是什么

把电视盒子臃肿的广告桌面换成一个干净的、苹果 tvOS 观感的桌面：

- **纯黑背景 + 底部四格 Dock**（tvOS 那个浅色圆角条的位置）
- **顶部大字显示**当前聚焦的应用名，带一圈取自应用封面的氛围光
- **按「下」键**应用网格从底部滑出
- **一块悬浮玻璃高光**，在图标之间弹性移动，而不是每个格子各画各的边框
- **四个磨砂按钮**：桌面设置、常用、输入源（HDMI / AV / 直播电视）、Wi-Fi / 设置
- **问候语 + 大号细体时钟 + 日期**（Outfit 字体）
- 可选的**时钟屏保**，防止烧屏

**无广告、无账号、无需 root、无需数据线**，纯 ADB 覆盖安装，一条命令可还原。

### 📦 轻量

安装包只有 **373 KB**（R8 裁剪 + 资源压缩的正式构建），比同类的 TV 桌面轻得多——
纯 Java 实现、仅依赖 `recyclerview` 与 `dynamicanimation` 两个轻量 AndroidX 库，
**没有引入 Compose / Glance 等重型框架，也没有内置广告 SDK 或推荐引擎**。
在 2 GB 内存的国产盒子上实测常驻内存约 **107 MB（PSS）**，运行流畅不拖后腿。
对内存吃紧的低配盒子来说，体积小本身就是优势——装它几乎不占空间。

### 中文版实机截图

在国产电视盒子上运行的样子（简体中文界面）：

![tvhome-zh 桌面截图](docs/screenshot-zh.png)

<details>
<summary>对比：原厂广告桌面（左） vs 本项目桌面（右）</summary>

![Before: stock Google TV home with a sponsored ad. After: the tv-vibehack launcher](docs/stock-vs-new-side.jpg)

</details>

## 和上游的差异

一句话概括：**上游把配置交给文件和命令行，本仓库把配置交到遥控器上。**

### 本仓库独有

| 功能 | 上游 | 本仓库 |
|---|---|---|
| ⭐ **编辑常用应用**（底部 Dock） | 只能改 `config.xml` 再重新编译 | **按遥控器菜单键**打开面板勾选，或**长按**图标置入/移出；改动存在电视本地 |
| 🎨 **壁纸** | 需用 ADB 把 `wallpaper.jpg` 推到电视上 | 面板里一键开启**必应每日壁纸**，或**从电视里选自己的图**；新图自动替换旧图，**空间恒定一张**，不会越攒越多 |
| 🔢 **每行图标数 3–8** | 只能推 `config.json` 或改配置重编译 | 面板里点一下循环切换；首次使用**按屏幕实际宽度自动推荐** |
| 🌓 **Dock 底板自适应** | 固定不透明，亮色壁纸下像一块黑砖 | 有壁纸时自动转为半透明压暗，纯黑背景时保持原样 |
| 🇨🇳 **中文界面** | 已有（`values-zh-rCN`） | 简繁中文齐全，另补齐德/西/法/俄/加泰/泰/阿/波/塞/土/挪/希/葡/芬/越/孟/捷/意/印尼/荷/乌兹/乌克兰，共 24 种语言 |
| ⌨️ **菜单键快捷设置** | 需改配置文件开启，且按键映射因电视而异 | **菜单键直接弹出**玻璃浮层（电视设置/显示/网络/管理应用/常用/桌面设置），可选择在别的应用里也接管 |
| 🐢 **低配优化** | 减弱动画只是配置文件里的一项；低内存时会自己保着磁贴不放 | **遥控器上一键切「减弱动画」**（补间全免，聚焦放大保留）；**内存紧张时自动放掉磁贴封面与壁纸**，回来再重建 |
| 🌤 **天气** | 独立 App，靠模块卡片挂上来 | **桌面时间下方一行**（城市+温度+天气），点开是玻璃面板：体感、空气质量、**每小时**、未来三天、**50 个常用城市直接点选**、**一键定位我的城市** |
| 🔌 **小米电视切信号源** | 无（标准切源接口在小米国行固件上无效） | **自动识别**小米国行固件，改走小米自己的播放器切源（HDMI 1/2/3、AV），**不用改任何设置**；海外固件不受影响 |
| 📦 **提供编译好的 APK** | 不提供二进制，需自行编译 | release 页直接下载（**373 KB** 正式构建），一条命令装上 |

### 本仓库暂缺（上游有，这里没有）

诚实地列出来，你需要的话请用上游：

- 主题目录一键推送（`themes/`）、模块卡片（其他应用可插入磁贴）
- 首启 AOT 预编译（本仓库是 R8 瘦构建，但不做 AOT）
- 桌面上直接切换 HOME 的快捷磁贴、VPN 应用标记、波斯历显示

其余部分（tvOS 观感、玻璃高光、时钟屏保、`config.json` 覆盖机制、去广告脚本、还原脚本等）
均来自上游，遵循原项目 MIT 许可证。

**默认配置保持通用**，不预设任何片商或设备专属设置，适合任意品牌电视盒子。

### ⭐ 编辑常用应用（底部 Dock）

Dock 就是底部那一排常用应用。两个入口，随你喜欢：

- **按遥控器菜单键**（有些遥控器叫「选项」/长按菜单）→ 弹出「常用应用」面板，列出全部已装应用，已固定的带勾，点一下切换；
- **长按任意应用图标** → 直接置入 Dock；Dock 已满时点它会顶替第一个位置。

选择保存在电视本地，**下次开机依然有效**。想清空就在面板里逐个取消勾选。

### 🎨 桌面设置面板

顶栏第一个磨砂按钮，点开后是一块面板，**所有设置都在这里，不用碰任何配置文件**：

- **必应每日壁纸**——开关打开即每天自动换一张（关掉只停止每日更换，当前壁纸会保留）；
- **每行图标数**——点一下在「自动 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6」之间循环，当前值和来源始终显示在标题下方；
- **从电视中选择图片**——调用系统文件选择器，电视里存的图都能用，自动裁剪适应屏幕；
- **移除壁纸**——恢复纯黑背景。

### 🔧 进阶：换主题 / 推配置（不用重新编译）

桌面启动时也会自动读取电视上的这个目录（可放 `config.json` 和 `wallpaper.jpg`）：

```
/sdcard/Android/data/com.gathin.tvhome/files/
```

- 放一张 `wallpaper.jpg` → 重启桌面即成为背景（删掉即恢复纯黑）；
- 放一个 `config.json` → 覆盖 Dock、列数、背景色等内置默认值。

仓库里的 [`tools/set-wallpaper.sh`](tools/set-wallpaper.sh) 是一键换壁纸脚本（`./set-wallpaper.sh <电视IP> <图片路径>`）。
走 ADB 推配置文件是给进阶用户用的；不想碰命令行的话，上面那个面板就够了。

## 设备兼容性

### Android 11 的包可见性（本项目能解决）

很多国产 TV 应用在 Android 11 上会出现「应用列表只显示几个 App」的问题——这是
**Android 11 包可见性**（package visibility）限制：应用必须声明 `<queries>` 才能看到其他应用。
本项目 `targetSdk 29`，在 Android 11 上属于「旧版行为」，能正常枚举全部应用，无需额外声明。

这在国产盒子（普遍停留在 Android 11）上尤其重要。

### 部分厂商固件拒绝安装第三方桌面（本项目解决不了）

极少数国产电视固件会**以自家原生桌面的签名做校验**，任何签名不同的桌面 APK 都会被拒绝安装，
在 ADB 下表现为 `INSTALL_FAILED_VERIFICATION_FAILURE`，日志里通常有类似
`verifier: signature does not match ... will not be installed!` 的记录。

已知情况：**部分 TCL 中国区固件**（如 tcl_mt5879_cn、falcon 鹤 6 等）会这样。上游同样被拒
（上游 README 亦记录 "A few China-market TCL sets refuse to install any launcher at all"）。

**但多数情况下能绕过去**，因为被拒的是"安装校验"这一步，而不是桌面本身。装之前先关掉它：

```bash
adb shell settings put global verifier_verify_adb_installs 0
adb install -r tvhome-zh.apk
```

或者在电视上：**设置 → 安全 → 安装验证

# LeRobot Workbench

本地可视化流水线工作台：用 **Java（Spring Boot）+ HTML/CSS/JS** 提供点击式界面，**所有业务通讯统一走 ROS**（开发默认 mock 总线，生产可接 `rosbridge`）。

```
浏览器 UI  ──HTTP/STOMP──►  Java Workbench
                              │
                              ▼
                         ROS Message Bus
                     (mock 或 rosbridge ws://)
                              │
                              ▼
                    Python Bridge / LeRobot CLI
```

## 功能模块

| 界面 | 对应能力 | 状态 |
|------|----------|------|
| 硬件准备 | find-port / calibrate / teleoperate | UI + ROS 服务就绪（mock 可点通） |
| 数据采集 | lerobot-record | UI + ROS 服务就绪 |
| 数据集 | 列表 / 详情 | UI + ROS 服务就绪 |
| 训练 | lerobot-train | UI + ROS 服务就绪 |
| 评估 / 部署 | eval / rollout | UI + ROS 服务就绪 |
| 数据对齐 | 多模态对齐整理 | 界面与服务占位，待深化 |
| 智能标注 | 自动识别标注 | 界面与服务占位，待深化 |
| 流水线 | 端到端编排视图 | 可用 |

## 快速启动

要求：JDK 17+、Maven、[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)。

**先装 Python 依赖（含录制所需的 `datasets` 等），再启 Java：**

```bash
# 在仓库根目录（不是 workbench/）
uv sync --extra workbench
# 或
bash workbench/setup_python.sh
```

只跑 `uv sync`（不带 extra）**不会**安装 `datasets`，录制会立刻报错。Workbench 启动录制时若检测到缺失，会尝试自动执行 `uv sync --extra workbench`。

**Docker 不是必须。** 本机已有 ROS（例如 Pixi + RoboStack 的 `~/work/dev/ros-learn`）时，一键部署会直接用本机 `pixi run ros2 launch rosbridge…`。

```bash
cd workbench
mvn -q spring-boot:run
```

浏览器打开：<http://localhost:8080> → 左侧 **ROS 环境**。

启动逻辑：

1. 探测本机 Pixi ROS 工程（`lerobot.ros.native-pixi-project`，默认 `~/work/dev/ros-learn`）
2. 若工程可用 → 「一键部署」安装/启动本机 rosbridge（可自动 `pixi add ros-humble-rosbridge-suite`）
3. 若没有本机 ROS，但有 Docker → 才走 Docker 备选
4. 都没有 → Mock，并提示配置路径

自定义本机 ROS 工程：

```bash
LEROBOT_ROS_PIXI=/path/to/your/ros-pixi-project mvn spring-boot:run
```

强制 Mock：`LEROBOT_ROS_MOCK=true mvn spring-boot:run`

## 配置

见 `src/main/resources/application.yml`：

- `lerobot.repo-root` — LeRobot 仓库根目录
- `lerobot.ros.mock` — `true` 用内存总线；`false` 连 rosbridge
- `lerobot.ros.rosbridge-url` — 默认 `ws://127.0.0.1:9090`
- `lerobot.ros.namespace` — 默认 `/lerobot`

## ROS 话题 / 服务约定

命名空间：`/lerobot`

| 名称 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| `/lerobot/status` | 总线状态 |
| `/lerobot/log` | 日志流 |
| `/lerobot/job/progress` | 任务进度 |
| `/lerobot/hardware/*` | 找端口 / 标定 / 遥操作 |
| `/lerobot/record/*` | 录制启停 |
| `/lerobot/train/*` | 训练启停 |
| `/lerobot/eval/start` `/rollout/start` | 评估与部署 |
| `/lerobot/dataset/*` | 数据集查询 |
| `/lerobot/align/run` `/annotate/run` | 对齐与标注（规划） |

## 架构说明

- **前端**：静态 SPA（hash 路由），SockJS + STOMP 收实时日志/进度
- **后端**：Spring Boot 编排层，不直接调 LeRobot Python API
- **ROS 层**：`RosMessageBus` 接口；`MockRosMessageBus` / `RosbridgeMessageBus` 可切换
- **桥接**：`bridge/python/lerobot_ros_bridge.py` 将服务调用映射为 `uv run lerobot-*`

## 后续路线

1. 用 `rclpy` 把桥接升级为正式 ROS2 节点（service + publisher）
2. 录制页嵌入相机预览（Rerun / Foxglove / WebRTC）
3. 实现数据对齐（时间戳校验、丢帧修补、特征一致性）
4. 接入 VLM / 关键帧模型做自动标注
5. 流水线页支持拖拽编排与一键复跑

content.readme:
# RealWorldMC

Explore real cities, fly over mountains and step into Google Maps Street View inside Minecraft Java. RealWorldMC brings Google Earth-style scenery into the game, with Minecraft blocks and mobs alongside street-level photos.

[Download](https://github.com/Teddy563/realworldmc/releases/latest) · [Website](https://realworldmc.com/) · [Setup guide](docs/setup.md) · [API keys and costs](docs/accounts-and-costs.md)

![RealWorldMC gameplay: New York, the Grand Canyon, Paris and the Golden Gate Bridge](docs/assets/gameplay-grid.jpg)

[Watch the flight preview](docs/assets/flight-preview.mp4)

## What you can do

- Fly over real-world 3D scenery and travel to places by name or coordinates.
- Use [automatic glide and hover](docs/flight.md) without wearing an elytra.
- Explore Street View, follow its arrows, place blocks and spawn mobs.
- Start each new world at one of [100 locations](docs/spawn-locations.md), including the Palace of Parliament in Bucharest.
- Try [experimental space flight](docs/space-flight.md), including Earth orbit and Moon or Mars flyovers. Moon and Mars do not have walkable surfaces.

**Recommended: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 with Fabric and Java 21.** Other Minecraft builds are experimental and have fewer features. See the [setup guide](docs/setup.md) for compatibility.

## Get started

1. Download the **1.21.1 `.mrpack`** from [Releases](https://github.com/Teddy563/realworldmc/releases/latest) and import it into Modrinth App or Prism Launcher. Already have a Fabric profile? Install the matching release **JAR** and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) instead.
2. Launch Minecraft. The **RealWorldMC setup** screen opens on first launch.
3. Choose Google or Cesium, enter your own credentials and test the connection. Add a Google Map Tiles API key for in-game Street View. [Follow the account setup steps](docs/accounts-and-costs.md).
4. Select **Save & finish**. The mod starts its local map services automatically.
5. Create a Creative world with commands enabled and choose **Real World** as the world type. Wait for the scenery to load, then explore.

Windows x64 releases include the service runtime. macOS and Linux need Node.js 22+; full gameplay testing on those platforms is still pending. Bedrock, mobile, Forge and NeoForge are not supported.

## Useful controls

| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/earth help` | Show commands |
| `/earth setup` | Change or test your keys |
| `/earth fly` | Toggle automatic glide and hover |
| `/earth goto 44.427454, 26.087287` | Visit the Palace of Parliament |
| `/earth streetview` | Enter the nearest Street View photo |
| `/earth back` | Return from Street View |

**F5** changes the camera. In Street View, **WASD** walks inside a 5×5 area; walking toward a connected stop prepares the next photo and crossing the outer boundary travels there. **V** toggles walking. See [all controls](docs/controls.md).

## Before you play

- Internet access and your own provider credentials are required. **Map usage can cost money.** Read [limits and billing](docs/accounts-and-costs.md) before adding keys.
- Coverage varies. Blocks approximate the scenery, and Street View photos do not provide building interiors or accurate wall depth.
- Shader and add-on compatibility varies. Check [known limitations](docs/limitations.md) and [troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md).
- When updating, back up your worlds, close Minecraft and replace the old JAR. Keep only one copy of RealWorldMC installed.

## Documentation

[All guides](docs/README.md) · [Recording guide](docs/media.md) · [Architecture](HANDOFF.md) · [Build instructions](docs/releases.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Credits and licence

Earth data comes from Google and OpenStreetMap, with Cesium available for 3D map access. Moon and Mars have separate [imagery credits](docs/planetary-data.md). Keep provider attribution visible when sharing captures.

Code: [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). Map and imagery assets have their own terms. Not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, Google or Cesium.

content.readme:
Luma

A calm, tvOS-inspired home screen for Android TV and Google TV.
Your favourite apps over living wallpapers, with no ads, no sponsored rows and no tracking.

Install  ·  Make it your home screen  ·  Support the project

Made by @0xProbabillity

## What it does Luma works on its own: it needs no smart home, account or other app. Everything below except the scene block works on any Android TV. - **A quiet Home.** A greeting with today's date, your favourite apps as large cards, and nothing you did not put there. Moving to an app shows its name and a line about it; hold OK on any app to show it on Home, move it or hide it. - **Home widgets, page by page.** Above your apps, Home can show *Up Next* (the shows and videos you were watching, from the Continue watching list that YouTube, Netflix and other apps share with Android TV: OK resumes where you stopped), *Weather* (now, the next hours or the coming days), *Now Playing* (music playing on the TV, with play, pause and skip), *Inputs* (on a TV: its HDMI ports and live TV; a PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Apple TV, Chromecast, Fire TV, soundbar and more are recognised over HDMI-CEC and shown under their own name and colour; OK switches to it and Home comes back) and *Control* (Wi-Fi, picture and sound, accessories, settings). Left and Right turn the pages; your apps stay underneath. - **Every app, one tab away.** *Apps* lists everything installed on the TV, hidden apps included. - **Light by day, dark at night.** The default wallpaper, *Silver*, is pale silver silk from sunrise to sunset and graphite silk after dark, and the whole interface turns light or dark with it. Sunrise and sunset are worked out for your TV's time zone, with no location permission and no network. - **Living wallpapers.** Eight of them, from silver silk and a Norwegian fjord at dusk to the Milky Way. On the fjord, clouds drift and the water moves very slowly, with real depth: the sky and the mountains travel at different speeds as you move. Everything pauses while an app is open. - **Feels like a TV, not a phone.** Springy focus, cards that tilt toward the direction you move, a pill that slides along the tab bar, and soft, quiet navigation sounds. *Fluid motion* and *Navigation sounds* turn off in Settings, and Android's own animation settings are respected. - **Your smart home, if you have one.** The scene block appears only when [House Control TV](https://github.com/0xProbabillity/house-control-tv) is installed: Home then also shows five round scene buttons and a live 3D model of your home floating on the wallpaper, and a scene can open an app as the lights go down (*Movie* starts Netflix). Without it, Home is just your greeting and favourites over the wallpaper, and Luma picks House Control up as soon as you install it. - **Easy to leave.** Settings → *Home screen* hands Home back to your TV's own launcher, and `./luma.sh restore` undoes everything the installer changed.

content.readme: # Android TV Makeover Debloat an Android TV over Wi-Fi, replace its ad-filled home screen with a clean Apple TV style launcher, control it from your phone, and add a fast live TV app for Indian channels. Everything is reversible. - **Launcher:** your photos fading behind the home screen, a dock of 5 apps, a 5-column app grid, clock and greeting, YouTube / Instagram / Facebook follower counters, HDMI/AV switcher. - **Phone remote:** a web page served by the TV. Trackpad, keyboard, volume, apps, inputs, sending photos to the TV, and Siri shortcuts. Works in Safari on iPhone and in any phone browser. - **Live TV app:** Indian channels in categories, 1080p only, smooth on a 1 GB TV. Built and tested on a Xiaomi MiTV-AXSO0 (Android TV 9, 1 GB RAM). It should work on most Android TV / Google TV sets (Xiaomi, TCL, Hisense, Sony, OnePlus, Realme, Nvidia Shield). It does not work on Samsung Tizen, LG webOS or Fire TV. | Home screen | Inputs menu | |---|---| | ![Launcher home](docs/images/launcher-home.png) | ![Inputs menu](docs/images/launcher-inputs.png) | | App grid (5 per row) | Phone remote | |---|---| | ![App grid](docs/images/launcher-grid.png) | | | Live TV app | Categories | |---|---| | ![Live TV](docs/images/live-tv-all.png) | ![News](docs/images/live-tv-news.png) | ## What's inside | Path | What it is | |---|---| | `launcher/` | Native Android TV launcher (Java, AndroidX RecyclerView, minSdk 28, ~40 MB RAM). Rotating photo wallpapers (or pitch black), a dock of five apps with a colour glow sampled from the focused app, a 5-column app grid below (the number per row is a setting), one glass focus highlight, clock and greeting in Outfit, frosted Inputs / Wi-Fi / Settings pills, follower counters, HDMI/AV/Live TV input switcher, deterministic D-pad navigation. Also runs the phone remote's web server. | | `apps/live-tv/` | Live TV app (Flutter), a modified fork of [kananinirav/Indian-IPTV-App](https://github.com/kananinirav/Indian-IPTV-App). Category sidebar, small channel logos, 1080p streams only, instant start from cache, Up/Down channel switching, automatic backup streams. See [apps/live-tv/README.md](apps/live-tv/README.md). | | `tools/tv` | Tiny ADB client in Python (`adb-shell`): `shell`, `screenshot`, `push`, `pull`, `key`. Works when macOS Local Network privacy blocks the stock `adb` binary. | | `profiles/` | Debloat profiles: which packages to disable for a given TV. | | `PROMPT.md` | The prompt to give a coding assistant (e.g. Claude Code) to do all of this on your TV, step by step, with screenshots. | ## Quick start On the TV: Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** 7 times, then go back → Developer options → turn on **USB debugging** (and Network/ADB debugging if your TV shows it). On a Mac or Linux computer on the same Wi-Fi: ```bash ./setup.sh ``` ```bash tools/find-tv.sh ``` Accept the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt on the TV (tick "Always allow"). Then back up first: ```bash ./backup.sh ``` ### 1. Debloat Profiles list packages to disable with `pm disable-user` (nothing is uninstalled). Package names differ between brands, so for another TV copy the profile and edit it; check what a package does with `tools/tv shell "dumpsys package "`. Never disable TV input services, the remote/Bluetooth services, the keyboard, or Play Store/Services. ```bash ./disable.sh profiles/xiaomi-mitv-axso0.txt ``` ### 2. Launcher Edit `launcher/app/src/main/res/values/config.xml` (dock apps, hidden apps, greeting name, wallpaper), then: ```bash ./build_and_install.sh ``` Needs JDK 17 and the Android SDK (platform 34, build-tools 34): `brew install openjdk@17` and `brew install --cask android-commandlinetools`, then `sdkmanager "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"`. If several apps claim Home, the script sets the default with `cmd package set-home-activity`. ### 3. Live TV app (optional) Needs Flutter (`brew install --cask flutter`): ```bash ./build_live_tv.sh ``` ### Undo everything ```bash ./restore.sh profiles/xiaomi-mitv-axso0.txt --uninstall ``` Or re-enable a single app: `tools/tv shell "pm enable "`. ## Phone remote The launcher serves a control page on your home Wi-Fi at `http://:8080` (the IP is in `.tv-ip` after `tools/find-tv.sh`, or in the TV's Wi-Fi settings). 1. Open it in Safari (or any phone browser) on the same Wi-Fi. 2. Tap **Pair with TV**. The TV asks "Allow this phone to control the TV?" over whatever is on screen: press Right, then OK on the remote. Each phone pairs once. 3. On iPhone: Share → **Add to Home Screen**, and it opens full-screen like an app. Four tabs: - **Remote:** a trackpad (swipe to move, tap for OK), Back, Home, play/pause, volume and mute, and a keyboard that types live into whatever search box is op
